    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 {cell: color} —— 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子（腾出的填底色）。"""
    out = {}
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell not in out:
                out[cell] = BG
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])}


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]

                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能还原成静态点，位置事先不可知：只在没有静态点的关里认领它们。
    # 判据：棋盘区存在非件、非底色、非色9 的单格 → 有静态点 → 不认领腾出格。
    has_static_dots = any(prev[r][col] not in (BG, 9) and prev[r][col] not in COLOR_OF_TIER.values()
                          for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0])))
    if has_static_dots:
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if v != BG}
    return exp

def _case(prev, action):

    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 {cell: color} —— 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子（腾出的填底色）。"""
    out = {}
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell not in out:
                out[cell] = BG
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走（第 0 关的引导点露出来、第 3 关的色7 物件飘过来），
    # 位置事先不可知：在这些物件包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格，盒外照常认领底色。
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] != 9 and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))

LEVEL = "L1"
SCOPE = ("只看 ACTION6:x,y 且 10<=y<63；换关返回 NA；REACH 内 ≥3 件或两件不同级返回 NA（没见过）；"

        "v4: 死于 a8573ce41bed5fd8——色7 追上 (27,32) 的 2×2 并压上去，那件消失、一个 1×1 出现在 (27,22)。"
        "件被毁不是本概念的事，但它让『没被点到的件不动』落空；毁件规律只见过一次，先把这种转移划出去"

        "什么算『追上』还说不清，先把『挨着』也划出去，规律留给 L6 的概念去写"

            "f69577c44363eda4", "a8dbb391a055b5cf"]

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, mover, mover_next, octagons)


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 {cell: color} —— 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领，其余填底色。"""
    out = {}
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out or cell in unsure:
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。色7 有模型（_lib.mover_next）：它将占的格子让给它；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    mv = mover(prev)
    if mv and after:
        nxt_mv = mover_next(mv, after)
        halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for p in after for r, col in piece_cells(p) for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
        if nxt_mv & halo:
            return None                                  # 色7 会挨上件，件可能被毁，不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell not in nxt_mv}
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, mover, mover_next, octagons)


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。色7 有模型（_lib.mover_next）：它将占的格子让给它；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    mv = mover(prev)
    if mv and after:
        nxt_mv = mover_next(mv, after)
        halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for p in after for r, col in piece_cells(p) for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
        if nxt_mv & halo:
            return None                                  # 色7 会挨上件，件可能被毁，不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell not in nxt_mv}
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

            "6ad59a999900f476", "756c29bd656094f0", "2c04ec89f25ea959", "5aeaa143202f0697", "04fc031a768f3ce1",
            "55ccf297a8d2140c", "5b7118503c3f63e7", "720d4f9031bb562d", "1c3a9aa1bacfeea4", "a8573ce41bed5fd8",

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, mover, mover_next, octagons, will_level_up)


def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    if will_level_up(prev, action):
        return None                                      # 过关那一步整屏重画，件画在哪本概念说不出
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。色7 有模型（_lib.mover_next）：它将占的格子让给它；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    mv = mover(prev)
    if mv and after:
        nxt_mv = mover_next(mv, after)
        halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for p in after for r, col in piece_cells(p) for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
        if nxt_mv & halo:
            return None                                  # 色7 会挨上件，件可能被毁，不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell not in nxt_mv}
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, mover, mover_next, octagons, will_level_up)


def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    if near and all(prev[r] == nxt[r] for r in range(len(prev)) if r != BUDGET_ROW):
        return "NA"                     # 世界整条驳回了这次点击，触发条件未知（NOTE v11）
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    if will_level_up(prev, action):
        return None                                      # 过关那一步整屏重画，件画在哪本概念说不出
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。色7 有模型（_lib.mover_next）：它将占的格子让给它；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    mv = mover(prev)
    if mv and after:
        nxt_mv = mover_next(mv, after)
        halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for p in after for r, col in piece_cells(p) for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
        if nxt_mv & halo:
            return None                                  # 色7 会挨上件，件可能被毁，不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell not in nxt_mv}
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()

from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, octagons, will_level_up,

def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    if near and all(prev[r] == nxt[r] for r in range(len(prev)) if r != BUDGET_ROW):
        return "NA"                     # 世界整条驳回了这次点击，触发条件未知（NOTE v11）
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def _blocks(g):
    """场上每只完整的物件 (颜色, 格集)。有一只被盖掉一部分就返回 None：重心算不准，落点也就算不准。"""
    out = []
    for colour in CREATURE_COLORS:
        for b, full in creature_blocks(g, colour):
            if not full:
                return None
            out.append((colour, frozenset(b)))
    return out


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    if will_level_up(prev, action):
        return None                                      # 过关那一步整屏重画，件画在哪本概念说不出
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。物件有落点模型（_lib.capture_landing）：它们将占的格子让给它们；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    crs = _blocks(prev)
    if crs is None:
        return None
    if crs and after:
        occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        freshcells = set(piece_cells(new)) if new else set()
        oldcells = {cell for p in after if p != new for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        ps_prev = list(pieces(prev))
        lands = []
        for colour, b in crs:
            if b & freshcells:
                return None                              # 新件盖在物件原位上：那只被甩到哪没模型（第 155/190 步）
            tgt, land = capture_landing(b, after, occupied, colour,
                                        ps_prev=ps_prev if colour == MOVER_COLOR else None)
            if land is None:
                return None
            if land & oldcells:
                return None                              # 捕获了没被点的件：那件降级后落在哪没模型（NOTE v10）
            lands.append(frozenset(land))
        allland = set().union(*lands) if lands else set()
        # 件画在物件上面：新件的格子照常认领；被物件占走的腾出格不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell in freshcells or cell not in allland}
        if len([land for land in lands if land & freshcells]) >= 2 and freshcells:
            r0 = min(r for r, _ in freshcells) - 5; r1 = max(r for r, _ in freshcells) + 5
            c0 = min(cc for _, cc in freshcells) - 5; c1 = max(cc for _, cc in freshcells) + 5
            exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
                   if cell in freshcells or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, octagons, will_level_up,
                  CREATURE_COLORS, creature_blocks, capture_landing)


def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    if near and all(prev[r] == nxt[r] for r in range(len(prev)) if r != BUDGET_ROW):
        return "NA"                     # 世界整条驳回了这次点击，触发条件未知（NOTE v11）
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def _blocks(g):
    """场上每只完整的物件 (颜色, 格集)。有一只被盖掉一部分就返回 None：重心算不准，落点也就算不准。"""
    out = []
    for colour in CREATURE_COLORS:
        for b, full in creature_blocks(g, colour):
            if not full:
                return None
            out.append((colour, frozenset(b)))
    return out


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    if will_level_up(prev, action):
        return None                                      # 过关那一步整屏重画，件画在哪本概念说不出
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。物件有落点模型（_lib.capture_landing）：它们将占的格子让给它们；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    crs = _blocks(prev)
    if crs is None:
        return None
    if crs and after:
        occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        freshcells = set(piece_cells(new)) if new else set()
        oldcells = {cell for p in after if p != new for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        ps_prev = list(pieces(prev))
        lands = []
        for colour, b in crs:
            if b & freshcells:
                return None                              # 新件盖在物件原位上：那只被甩到哪没模型（第 155/190 步）
            tgt, land = capture_landing(b, after, occupied, colour,
                                        ps_prev=ps_prev if colour == MOVER_COLOR else None)
            if land is None:
                return None
            if land & oldcells:
                return None                              # 捕获了没被点的件：那件降级后落在哪没模型（NOTE v10）
            lands.append(frozenset(land))
        allland = set().union(*lands) if lands else set()
        # 件画在物件上面：新件的格子照常认领；被物件占走的腾出格不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell in freshcells or cell not in allland}
        if len([land for land in lands if land & freshcells]) >= 2:
            return None                              # 这一步要并：新物件生在哪说不出，件本身也未必保得住（第 147 步）
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

            "6ad59a999900f476", "756c29bd656094f0", "2c04ec89f25ea959", "5aeaa143202f0697", "04fc031a768f3ce1",
            "55ccf297a8d2140c", "5b7118503c3f63e7", "720d4f9031bb562d", "1c3a9aa1bacfeea4", "a8573ce41bed5fd8",
            "f69577c44363eda4", "a8dbb391a055b5cf", "c54b78f52b0ef1fd", "868bde228addb7ee", "896e274a965f31be",

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, octagons, will_level_up,
                  CREATURE_COLORS, creature_blocks, capture_landing)


def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y, prev))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y, prev))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    if near and all(prev[r] == nxt[r] for r in range(len(prev)) if r != BUDGET_ROW):
        return "NA"                     # 世界整条驳回了这次点击，触发条件未知（NOTE v11）
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def _blocks(g):
    """场上每只完整的物件 (颜色, 格集)。有一只被盖掉一部分就返回 None：重心算不准，落点也就算不准。"""
    out = []
    for colour in CREATURE_COLORS:
        for b, full in creature_blocks(g, colour):
            if not full:
                return None
            out.append((colour, frozenset(b)))
    return out


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    if will_level_up(prev, action):
        return None                                      # 过关那一步整屏重画，件画在哪本概念说不出
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。物件有落点模型（_lib.capture_landing）：它们将占的格子让给它们；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    crs = _blocks(prev)
    if crs is None:
        return None
    if crs and after:
        occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        freshcells = set(piece_cells(new)) if new else set()
        oldcells = {cell for p in after if p != new for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        ps_prev = list(pieces(prev))
        lands = []
        for colour, b in crs:
            if b & freshcells:
                return None                              # 新件盖在物件原位上：那只被甩到哪没模型（第 155/190 步）
            tgt, land = capture_landing(b, after, occupied, colour,
                                        ps_prev=ps_prev if colour == MOVER_COLOR else None)
            if land is None:
                return None
            if land & oldcells:
                return None                              # 捕获了没被点的件：那件降级后落在哪没模型（NOTE v10）
            lands.append(frozenset(land))
        allland = set().union(*lands) if lands else set()

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, octagons, will_level_up,
                  CREATURE_COLORS, creature_blocks, capture_landing)


def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y, prev))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y, prev))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    if near and all(prev[r] == nxt[r] for r in range(len(prev)) if r != BUDGET_ROW):
        return "NA"                     # 世界整条驳回了这次点击，触发条件未知（NOTE v11）
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def _blocks(g):
    """场上每只完整的物件 (颜色, 格集)。有一只被盖掉一部分就返回 None：重心算不准，落点也就算不准。"""
    out = []
    for colour in CREATURE_COLORS:
        for b, full in creature_blocks(g, colour):
            if not full:
                return None
            out.append((colour, frozenset(b)))
    return out


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    if will_level_up(prev, action):
        return None                                      # 过关那一步整屏重画，件画在哪本概念说不出
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。物件有落点模型（_lib.capture_landing）：它们将占的格子让给它们；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    crs = _blocks(prev)
    if crs is None:
        return None
    if crs and after:
        occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        freshcells = set(piece_cells(new)) if new else set()
        oldcells = {cell for p in after if p != new for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        ps_prev = list(pieces(prev))
        lands = []
        for colour, b in crs:
            if b & freshcells:
                return None                              # 新件盖在物件原位上：那只被甩到哪没模型（第 155/190 步）
            tgt, land = capture_landing(b, after, occupied, colour,
                                        ps_prev=ps_prev if colour == MOVER_COLOR else None,
                                        shape=(len(prev), len(prev[0])))
            if land is None:
                return None
            if land & oldcells:
                return None                              # 捕获了没被点的件：那件降级后落在哪没模型（NOTE v10）
            lands.append(frozenset(land))
        allland = set().union(*lands) if lands else set()
        # 件画在物件上面：新件的格子照常认领；被物件占走的腾出格不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell in freshcells or cell not in allland}
        if len([land for land in lands if land & freshcells]) >= 2:
            return None                              # 这一步要并：新物件生在哪说不出，件本身也未必保得住（第 147 步）
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

就是这么来的：这两格是件腾出来的，本概念把「追猎者会占走的格」让开，而让开的位置比世界实际的位置偏了一列，于是两格被押成底色。v15: 主张、assert_ 都没动，只在 apply 里补一道闸。由来是第 305 步（终局卡）退出码 5：点 (列13,行39) 把 5 级件从 (行36,列1) 搬到 (行37,列11)，色7 在 列17-21；本概念按 capture_landing 算它会落到 列15-19（贴着点击后那件的右边），于是把那几格让开、把件腾出的 (39,5) 押成底色。世界给的是 列5-9——贴着那件点击前的位置的右边，整整差 10 列。这一档不是本概念该算的：色7 到刚落下的新件只隔 2 格，不超过 REACH，正是 mover7_lands_when_target_unique 明说没有模型的「甩飞档」——它自己的 apply 在这一档整条返回 None，而本概念绕过那四道闸直接用了词汇里的原始公式 capture_landing，等于替一条已经声明闭嘴的概念开口。教训和 v7 是同一条、方向相反：生成器超额主张闸看不见，只有 --strict 看得见；而超额的来源这次是从共用词取值时把上游的 scope 丢了——词汇是假设，它的适用范围写在引用它的那条概念里，不在词本身。补的闸就照抄那一档：色7 离新件不超过 REACH 就整条不认领（外扩一圈圈不住，它能被扔到十几格外）。代价照记：件被搬到追猎者跟前的那一类步，本概念从此一格不押——而那正是本关每一步都要走的路。

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, octagons, will_level_up,
                  CREATURE_COLORS, creature_blocks, capture_landing, piece_gap, REACH)


def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y, prev))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y, prev))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    if near and all(prev[r] == nxt[r] for r in range(len(prev)) if r != BUDGET_ROW):
        return "NA"                     # 世界整条驳回了这次点击，触发条件未知（NOTE v11）
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):

                continue

def _blocks(g):
    """场上每只完整的物件 (颜色, 格集)。有一只被盖掉一部分就返回 None：重心算不准，落点也就算不准。"""
    out = []
    for colour in CREATURE_COLORS:
        for b, full in creature_blocks(g, colour):
            if not full:
                return None
            out.append((colour, frozenset(b)))
    return out


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):

    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    crs = _blocks(prev)
    if crs is None:
        return None
    if crs and after:
        occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        freshcells = set(piece_cells(new)) if new else set()
        oldcells = {cell for p in after if p != new for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        ps_prev = list(pieces(prev))
        lands = []
        for colour, b in crs:
            if b & freshcells:
                return None                              # 新件盖在物件原位上：那只被甩到哪没模型（第 155/190 步）

            tgt, land = capture_landing(b, after, occupied, colour,

            if land is None:
                return None
            if land & oldcells:
                return None                              # 捕获了没被点的件：那件降级后落在哪没模型（NOTE v10）
            lands.append(frozenset(land))
        allland = set().union(*lands) if lands else set()
        # 件画在物件上面：新件的格子照常认领；被物件占走的腾出格不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell in freshcells or cell not in allland}
        if len([land for land in lands if land & freshcells]) >= 2:
            return None                              # 这一步要并：新物件生在哪说不出，件本身也未必保得住（第 147 步）
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, octagons, will_level_up,
                  CREATURE_COLORS, creature_blocks, capture_landing, piece_gap, REACH)


def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y, prev))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y, prev))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    if near and all(prev[r] == nxt[r] for r in range(len(prev)) if r != BUDGET_ROW):
        return "NA"                     # 世界整条驳回了这次点击，触发条件未知（NOTE v11）
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def _blocks(g):
    """场上每只完整的物件 (颜色, 格集)。有一只被盖掉一部分就返回 None：重心算不准，落点也就算不准。"""
    out = []
    for colour in CREATURE_COLORS:
        for b, full in creature_blocks(g, colour):
            if not full:
                return None
            out.append((colour, frozenset(b)))
    return out


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    if will_level_up(prev, action):
        return None                                      # 过关那一步整屏重画，件画在哪本概念说不出
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。物件有落点模型（_lib.capture_landing）：它们将占的格子让给它们；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    crs = _blocks(prev)
    if crs is None:
        return None
    if crs and after:
        occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        freshcells = set(piece_cells(new)) if new else set()
        oldcells = {cell for p in after if p != new for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        ps_prev = list(pieces(prev))
        lands = []
        for colour, b in crs:
            if b & freshcells:
                return None                              # 新件盖在物件原位上：那只被甩到哪没模型（第 155/190 步）
            if colour == MOVER_COLOR and new is not None and piece_gap(b, new) <= REACH:
                return None                              # 甩飞档：色7 离刚落下的新件不超过 REACH，落点没模型（NOTE v15）
            tgt, land = capture_landing(b, after, occupied, colour,
                                        ps_prev=ps_prev if colour == MOVER_COLOR else None,
                                        shape=(len(prev), len(prev[0])))
            if land is None:
                return None
            if land & oldcells:
                return None                              # 捕获了没被点的件：那件降级后落在哪没模型（NOTE v10）
            lands.append(frozenset(land))
        allland = set().union(*lands) if lands else set()
        # 件画在物件上面：新件的格子照常认领；被物件占走的腾出格不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell in freshcells or cell not in allland}
        if len([land for land in lands if land & freshcells]) >= 2:
            return None                              # 这一步要并：新物件生在哪说不出，件本身也未必保得住（第 147 步）
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

None，而本概念绕过那四道闸直接用了词汇里的原始公式 capture_landing，等于替一条已经声明闭嘴的概念开口。教训和 v7 是同一条、方向相反：生成器超额主张闸看不见，只有 --strict 看得见；而超额的来源这次是从共用词取值时把上游的 scope 丢了——词汇是假设，它的适用范围写在引用它的那条概念里，不在词本身。补的闸就照抄那一档：色7 离新件不超过 REACH from geo import cells_of
from _lib import (click_xy, pieces, piece_cells, placed, in_reach, TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW, BUDGET_ROW,
                  COLOR_OF_TIER, BG, MOVER_COLOR, OCT_COLOR, capacity, octagons, will_level_up,
                  CREATURE_COLORS, creature_blocks, capture_landing, piece_gap, REACH)


def _cap(g):
    """棋盘上件的总容量。合成守恒，所以它掉了就一定是有件被毁/降级。"""
    return sum(capacity(t) for t, _, _ in pieces(g))


def _case(prev, action):
    xy = click_xy(action)
    if xy is None:
        return None
    x, y = xy
    if y <= TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW or y >= BUDGET_ROW:
        return None
    near = [p for p in pieces(prev) if in_reach(p, x, y)]
    if len(near) == 0:
        return (x, y, near, None)
    if len(near) == 1:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0], x, y, prev))
    if len(near) == 2 and near[0][0] == near[1][0] and near[0][0] + 1 in COLOR_OF_TIER:
        return (x, y, near, placed(near[0][0] + 1, x, y, prev))
    return None


def _expected(prev, x, y, near, new):
    """返回 (exp, skip)：exp = {cell: color} 新件的格子与旧件腾出的格子，skip = 说不出来的腾出格。
    腾出的格子填「那一格底下是什么」：在色9 八边形上就填色9（圈是静态背景），认不出原点的碎块附近不认领。"""
    out, skip = {}, set()
    if new is not None:
        for cell in piece_cells(new):
            out[cell] = COLOR_OF_TIER[new[0]]
    known, unsure = octagons(prev)
    for p in near:
        for cell in piece_cells(p):
            if cell in out:
                continue
            if cell in unsure:
                skip.add(cell)
                continue
            out[cell] = OCT_COLOR if cell in known else BG
    ok = lambda cell: TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < cell[0] < BUDGET_ROW and 0 <= cell[1] < len(prev[0])
    return {cell: v for cell, v in out.items() if ok(cell)}, {cell for cell in skip if ok(cell)}


PIECE_COLORS = set(COLOR_OF_TIER.values())


def _foreign(v):
    """非底色、非件色 = 本概念不负责的东西（色9 圈、色3 引导点、色7 会动的物件）。"""
    return v != BG and v not in PIECE_COLORS


def assert_(prev, action, nxt, ctx=None):
    if ctx and ctx.get("level_prev") != ctx.get("level_next"):
        return "NA"
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return "NA"
    if _cap(nxt) < _cap(prev):
        return "NA"                     # 这一步有件被降级，它落在哪本概念说不出（NOTE v10）
    x, y, near, new = c
    if near and all(prev[r] == nxt[r] for r in range(len(prev)) if r != BUDGET_ROW):
        return "NA"                     # 世界整条驳回了这次点击，触发条件未知（NOTE v11）
    exp, skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 色7 压到或挨着点击后的件 = 可能毁件，不归本概念管
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
    halo = {(r + dr, col + dc) for r, col in occupied for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)}
    mover_nxt = {(r, col) for r, col in cells_of(nxt, MOVER_COLOR) if TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW < r < BUDGET_ROW}
    if mover_nxt & halo:
        return "NA"
    for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW):
        for col in range(len(prev[0])):
            if (r, col) in skip:
                continue                    # 认不出原点的色9 碎块附近：腾出格底下是什么说不准
            want = exp.get((r, col), prev[r][col])
            got = nxt[r][col]
            if got == want:
                continue
            # 新件该占的格子严格核对；其余格子上有非件颜色就不归本概念管
            if want in PIECE_COLORS and exp.get((r, col)) == want:
                return "FALSE"
            if _foreign(prev[r][col]) or _foreign(got):
                continue
            return "FALSE"
    return "TRUE"


def _blocks(g):
    """场上每只完整的物件 (颜色, 格集)。有一只被盖掉一部分就返回 None：重心算不准，落点也就算不准。"""
    out = []
    for colour in CREATURE_COLORS:
        for b, full in creature_blocks(g, colour):
            if not full:
                return None
            out.append((colour, frozenset(b)))
    return out


def apply(prev, action, ctx=None):
    c = _case(prev, action)
    if c is None:
        return None
    if will_level_up(prev, action):
        return None                                      # 过关那一步整屏重画，件画在哪本概念说不出
    x, y, near, new = c
    exp, _skip = _expected(prev, x, y, near, new)
    # 腾出的格子可能被非件颜色占走。物件有落点模型（_lib.capture_landing）：它们将占的格子让给它们；
    # 其余非件颜色（第 0 关的引导点）位置事先不可知：在它们包围盒外扩 8 格的范围内不认领腾出格。
    after = [p for p in pieces(prev) if p not in near] + ([new] if new else [])
    crs = _blocks(prev)
    if crs is None:
        return None
    if crs and after:
        occupied = {cell for p in after for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        freshcells = set(piece_cells(new)) if new else set()
        oldcells = {cell for p in after if p != new for cell in piece_cells(p)}
        ps_prev = list(pieces(prev))
        lands = []
        for colour, b in crs:
            if b & freshcells:
                return None                              # 新件盖在物件原位上：那只被甩到哪没模型（第 155/190 步）
            if colour == MOVER_COLOR and new is not None and piece_gap(b, new) <= REACH:
                return None                              # 甩飞档：色7 离刚落下的新件不超过 REACH，落点没模型（NOTE v15）
            tgt, land = capture_landing(b, after, occupied, colour,
                                        ps_prev=ps_prev if colour == MOVER_COLOR else None,
                                        shape=(len(prev), len(prev[0])))
            if land is None:
                return None
            if land & oldcells:
                return None                              # 捕获了没被点的件：那件降级后落在哪没模型（NOTE v10）
            lands.append(frozenset(land))
        allland = set().union(*lands) if lands else set()
        # 件画在物件上面：新件的格子照常认领；被物件占走的腾出格不认领
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items() if cell in freshcells or cell not in allland}
        if len([land for land in lands if land & freshcells]) >= 2:
            return None                              # 这一步要并：新物件生在哪说不出，件本身也未必保得住（第 147 步）
    foreign = [(r, col) for r in range(TOP_BAND_LAST_ROW + 1, BUDGET_ROW) for col in range(len(prev[0]))
               if prev[r][col] not in (9, MOVER_COLOR) and _foreign(prev[r][col])]
    if foreign:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in foreign) - 8; r1 = max(r for r, _ in foreign) + 8
        c0 = min(c for _, c in foreign) - 8; c1 = max(c for _, c in foreign) + 8
        exp = {cell: v for cell, v in exp.items()
               if v != BG or not (r0 <= cell[0] <= r1 and c0 <= cell[1] <= c1)}
    return exp

            "f69577c44363eda4", "a8dbb391a055b5cf", "c54b78f52b0ef1fd", "868bde228addb7ee", "896e274a965f31be",
